id_algorithm: first 16 bytes of SHA256('cyberguard-bulk-v1|<seed>|id|<index>') with UUID v4 version/variant bits
rng_algorithm: per event: SHA256('cyberguard-bulk-v1|<seed>|ev|<index>|' + 4-byte counter) split into 64-bit unsigned integers; choices use integer modulo/cumulative weights only
profiles_are_prefixes: profile N contains exactly event indices [0, N)
